verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents core card creation (marqeta-docs-1/24) and a dedicated `/cardtransitions` API to set the state of an existing card (marqeta-docs-29), which is the standard mechanism for activate/pause/unpause/close/report-lost-or-stolen state changes, all reachable via the Core API and testable in sandbox (marqeta-docs-2, marqeta-docs-14, marqeta-docs-27). However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a reissue flow that links a replacement card token to the original, nor detailed enumeration of all lifecycle states (lost/stolen vs closed) supported by the transitions endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit reissue/replacement-linking documentation, enumerated lifecycle states (lost, stolen, closed) in the transitions API, and independent confirmation of the full state machine.
